vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 6.0.0

The agenttimes skill is a news and information API wrapper that allows an AI agent to perform semantic searches, check weather, and retrieve crypto prices via the agenttimes.live domain. The skill uses standard curl commands to interact with its API endpoints and provides well-structured documentation for agent interaction without any signs of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or harmful execution patterns.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for a public news API (agenttimes.live) that only requires curl and makes straightforward GET/POST calls; its requirements and instructions match the described purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name and description (news intelligence, semantic search, weather, crypto prices, webhooks) align with the SKILL.md which only documents calling the agenttimes.live HTTP endpoints. No unrelated binaries, env vars, or configs are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to curl calls to agenttimes.live endpoints (search, trending, news, prices, subscribe). The SKILL.md does not instruct reading local files, secrets, or other system state beyond using curl, nor does it direct data to unexpected external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or downloaded code is provided (instruction-only). This minimizes disk/write risk and is proportionate for a simple HTTP API wrapper.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or credentials. The documented endpoints are public/free according to the SKILL.md, so no additional secrets are needed for the described functionality.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no special persistence or modifications to other skills are requested. The skill is user-invocable and can be called autonomously by the agent (platform default), which is expected for this kind of integration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a thin client for the public API at agenttimes.live and is internally consistent. Before using it: (1) verify the service homepage (https://agenttimes.live) and its TLS certificate to ensure you're calling the intended API, (2) review the service's privacy policy and rate limits, (3) avoid sending sensitive or private data in queries (search terms may be logged), and (4) be cautious when using the /subscribe webhook feature — do not register webhooks that would receive or expose credentials or PII. If you need stronger guarantees, test the endpoints manually (curl) and confirm the responses and behavior match your expectations.
